blocks.prompt: 10. The \(7^{\text{th}}\) term and \(21^{\text{st}}\) term of an A.P. are 37 and 107 respectively. Find the A.P. and its \(100^{\text{th}}\) term.
blocks.explanation:
Do terms maloom hain, aur do hi cheezein na-maloom hain: \(a_1\) aur \(d\). Do maloomat se do unknowns mil jate hain.
'A.P. find karo' ka matlab hai us ki pehli chand terms likh do; saath \(a_{100}\) bhi chahiye.
Plan: do equations, minus kar ke \(d\), wapas rakh kar \(a_1\), phir general term se 100th term.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_7 = 37,\ a_{21} = 107\)
Humein find karna hai: A.P. aur \(a_{100}\).
Tareeqa: \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) ko \(n = 7\) aur \(n = 21\) ke liye likhenge. 'Respectively' (yani isi tarteeb se) ka matlab hai 7th term 37 aur 21st term 107 hai, ulat nahi.

Do equations likhein
\[a_1 + 6d = 37 \quad (1)\]
\[a_1 + 20d = 107 \quad (2)\]
Kyun: 7th term tak 6 qadam aur 21st term tak 20 qadam. Har qadam par \(d\) jama hota hai.

\(d\) aur \(a_1\) nikalein
\[(2) - (1):\ 14d = 70\]
\[d = 5\]
\[a_1 = 37 - 6(5) = 7\]
Kyun: Minus karne se \(a_1\) cancel ho gaya aur sirf \(d\) bacha. Phir \(d = 5\) ko equation (1) mein rakha: \(a_1 + 30 = 37\), to \(a_1 = 7\).
Dhyan dein: Equations ko minus karte waqt dono sides ko poora minus karein: \(107 - 37 = 70\) aur \(20d - 6d = 14d\).

A.P. aur \(a_{100}\) likhein
\[7,\ 12,\ 17,\ 22,\ \ldots\]
\[a_{100} = 7 + 99(5)\]
\[= 7 + 495 = 502\]
Kyun: 7 se shuru kar ke har dafa 5 jama kiya to A.P. bani. 100th term ke liye 99 qadam chahiye, yani \(99 \times 5 = 495\).

Tasdeeq
\[a_7 = 7 + 6(5) = 37 \;\checkmark\]
\[a_{21} = 7 + 20(5) = 107 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Hamari A.P. ne dono di hui terms wapas de deen, to \(a_1\) aur \(d\) sahi hain aur 502 bhi.
